description: This Java class 'ShoppingListEvents' manages shopping list operations within the OFBiz framework, including adding items from cart, creating and restoring auto-save lists, and handling shopping list cookies.

classes.name: ShoppingListEvents
classes.description: Handles shopping list operations such as adding, updating, auto-saving, restoring, and cookie management within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: addBulkFromCart
methods.description: Adds multiple cart items to a shopping list, creating the list if necessary.

methods.name: addListToCart
methods.description: Adds items from a shopping list to the shopping cart.

methods.name: replaceShoppingListItem
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a shopping list item.

methods.name: getAutoSaveListId
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a specialized auto-save shopping list ID.

methods.name: fillAutoSaveList
methods.description: Populates the auto-save shopping list with current cart items.

methods.name: saveCartToAutoSaveList
methods.description: Saves the current shopping cart to the auto-save list.

methods.name: restoreAutoSaveList
methods.description: Restores the auto-save shopping list into the shopping cart.

methods.name: clearListInfo
methods.description: Removes all items and survey responses from a shopping list.

methods.name: makeListItemSurveyResp
methods.description: Creates survey response records for a shopping list item.

methods.name: getItemAttributeInfos
methods.description: Retrieves attribute information for shopping list items.

methods.name: getItemSurveyInfos
methods.description: Retrieves survey response IDs for shopping list items.

methods.name: getItemSurveyInfo
methods.description: Retrieves survey response IDs for a specific shopping list item.

methods.name: createGuestShoppingListCookies
methods.description: Creates cookies for guest users to store shopping list ID.
